provenance: Unmodified polyline vertices copied from the original vector PDFs used in Rosemberg et al. (2025d), Figs. 4–5. Coordinates are in PDF/SVG page units, with the source tick positions retained for an affine axis transform. No interpolation, smoothing, or rerunning experiments.
selection: 20 evenly spaced source-order indices among the 93 displayed scenario paths; the full original mean and nominal paths are retained. Axis range 0–1% is a displayed crop only.
